newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - April 24.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - April 24.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
Fertilizer and chemical group to release half year results, due at about midday.
Stationary group reported a 1996/97 net loss of A$5.95 million on Wednesday after the market closde.

The Sydney Morning Herald newspaper reports that South Africa's Wooltru Ltd was expected to confirm today that it has a 14.6 percent stake in the upmarket clothing and home furnishings retailer following recent heavy trade in the stock.

Gaming group shares soared on Wednesday on rumours of renewed hopes of a capital return to shareholders following a decision by the New South Wales government to float its betting agency business TAB and excluding other gaming groups from taking an interest in TAB.
* Bank of Western Australia Ltd A$2.53 (+.01)
Bank reported a drop in 1996/97 annual profit on Wednesday and said it would be hard to sustain current profit levels due to intense competition, lower lending rates and restructuring costs.
